headline: Kim vows more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump offer
pages: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited nuclear material production sites and called for building more nuclear weapons, state media said Thursday. The trip came days after he ignored US President Donald Trump's offer to meet during Trump's recent visit to Asia. The Korean Central News Agency said Kim inspected two factories that make nuclear materials, one newly opened and one being expanded. Photos showed rows of what appeared to be uranium enrichment centrifuges. Kim cited US and South Korean threats and called his nuclear status an irreversible reality. He also stressed the need to deploy low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons.

One Seoul analyst said the message is that Pyongyang will not discuss denuclearization, which remains the US position. The visit signals Kim is rejecting any talks aimed at giving up the arsenal. Source: NPR.
